title: Stubai Full Catalog Curation - normalized model migration

UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --no-config python -m app.data.validate_catalog_curation typed REPORT.json --markdown-output REPORT.md

UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --no-config python -m app.data.validate_catalog_curation reconcile REPORT.json --base-catalog-path BASE/app/data/catalog.json --current-catalog-path app/data/catalog.json --base-trust-manifest-path BASE/app/data/resort_trust_manifest.json --current-trust-manifest-path app/data/resort_trust_manifest.json
ranking_impact_summary: Ranking-relevant facts now attach to the normalized ski-area, stay-base, and access-edge owners; Search V3 scoring policy is unchanged.
unresolved_caveats: Official Stubai pages did not yet publish a reviewed 2026/27 winter skiing window during this sweep; exact season_windows record the latest reviewed 2025/26 winter window.
Official terrain data distinguishes 65 km fall-line distance from 108 km effective route distance; total_piste_km stores the 108 km user-facing effective route distance.
Difficulty-km split remains unset because the source includes ski routes and infrastructure categories that do not map cleanly to the current beginner/intermediate/advanced model.
Destination-level coordinates and base elevation remain product-normalized for the glacier-plus-valley destination; exact stay-base identities are now captured with OSM relation IDs.
Accommodation and rental price ranges remain product-curated estimates until a provider sampling policy is reviewed.
Version-2-only fields were not assessed by the original version-1 curation and require source-backed follow-up.
